Title: Think Pink Eye Spreads Just By Looking? That's a Myth

Description:
Pink eye happens when bacteria or viruses reach the conjunctiva, the membrane covering your eye - and it spreads through direct contact, not eye contact. Touching your eyes with unwashed hands, sleeping in contact lenses, and sharing towels or pillowcases are three everyday ways it gets passed along.

Watch to see what to change so you can close off each pathway of spread.
